historical_context.time_period: Industrial Greathold, after standardized civic pumps have become load-bearing and while adaptive ecological responses remain institutionally disputed
historical_context.location: Cistern House Nine, a seal-bearing public pump workshop serving a terraced Hold beside a warm underground sea.
historical_context.summary: An ordinary pump-surety renewal becomes an allocation crisis when rune-disrupting mites stop an insured engine and the evidence that explains the failure also activates the contract's deep-pattern exclusion.

public_facts.text: Cistern House Nine has a public landing, dry rune gallery, wet intake chamber, three pump engines, visible pressure floats and valves, removable isolation wedges, a municipal crystal feed, and a workshop inspection plate.
District pump service may depend simultaneously on a Forge Consortium's matched parts, a local sealed workshop, reserve-house surety, crystal allotments, and lift-office freight priority.

Standard pump sureties can cover named mechanical or local-creature failures while excluding coordinated ecological response, undocumented rerouting, and organisms adapted to standardized rune arrays.
A workshop Master can bind one seal and widen a local dispute, but apprentices, journeyworkers, tenants, and wage workers do not gain a civic seal merely by paying or performing the work.

ambient_pressures.text: The physical evidence most useful for diagnosing adaptive ecological injury can also give the reserve house grounds to refuse the repair claim.
A failed cistern moves labour, freight, crystal, and debt before any institution settles its cause; bakeries, clinics, laundries, public kitchens, and households bear those movements directly.
Restoring water through insurance, pooled workshop credit, winter reserve, or bounded delving moves scarcity into a different owner and time horizon instead of abolishing it.

groups.label: Cistern House Nine workshop
institutional_logic: Keep district water moving through a materially safe pump state.
Attach the workshop seal to inspection, maintenance, and any claim classification it can defend.
material_incentives: Obtain matched replacement parts and crystal before the upper tanks empty.
Preserve workshop credit without hiding a failure that will attack the same design again.
internal_shames: Losing a public service through private pride
Making a journeyworker carry a Master's lie
prestige_markers: A pump still repairable after decades
A claim ledger whose physical evidence agrees with the seal
A district willing to widen the workshop's order
taboo_triggers: An insurer treating the public workshop as a disposable loss sink
A public slate exposing discrepancies between seal and machine
emotional_display_norms: Fear is compressed into measurements, parts custody, work assignments, and dry correction until the water clock makes restraint impossible.
trust_defaults: Trusts visible isolation, repeatable inspection, competent hands, and records that attach each decision to an owner.

groups.label: Reserve-house surety assessors
institutional_logic: Guarantee failures whose cause and cost can be bounded by a named table.
Keep correlated deep-pattern losses outside any single reserve house's promises.
material_incentives: Prevent one adaptive failure pattern from consuming reserves pledged across many Holds.
Control claim evidence strongly enough to request scarce relief freight.
internal_virtues: A refusal issued before false hope spends freight
internal_shames: Discovering that supposedly independent risks share one deep cause
A refusal plate hidden from the affected district
prestige_markers: A red rule accepted by both repairer and claimant
A reserve book that survives winter
Fast freight for a clean life-service claim
taboo_triggers: Calling an unbounded systemic risk ordinary wear
A workshop changing cause after inspection custody closes
emotional_display_norms: Concern is expressed as narrower promises, cleaner custody, and quieter language.
trust_defaults: Trusts sealed housings, named causes, shared measurements, and solvent orders more than testimony about unprecedented behavior.

groups.label: Forge Consortium pump supply
institutional_logic: Sell standardized spell engines and keep matched assemblies moving through controlled supply routes.
Use service notes and parts compatibility to secure repayment across long operating lives.
material_incentives: Prioritize solvent and covered orders when matched parts are scarce.
Keep local technicians dependent on consortium models and replacement arrays.
internal_shames: A standard array becoming a standard ecological target
A public pump failing while its debt remains current
prestige_markers: A maintenance workforce fluent in the model
taboo_triggers: Local substitution that bypasses proprietary matching
A delinquent order demanding priority over a solvent customer
emotional_display_norms: Urgency is translated into order position, warranty status, and freight marks.
trust_defaults: Trusts standardized parts, paid service notes, and contracted duty limits.

groups.label: Terrace households and water-dependent work
institutional_logic: Keep homes, clinics, bakeries, laundries, and public kitchens supplied.
Make service debt and emergency charges visible where non-seal holders can contest them.
material_incentives: Receive water before stored vessels empty.
Keep repair costs from being passed automatically to every connection while workshop owners choose the terms.
internal_shames: Hiding a surcharge in restored service
Treating unsealed labour as politically silent because it is legally voteless
prestige_markers: A clinic can filled before a private bath
A charge traced to the seal that chose it
taboo_triggers: Being told a dry tap is only a technical matter
Restored water presented as free when winter heat or household credit paid for it
emotional_display_norms: Pressure appears first as vessels, queues, missed shifts, posted figures, and exact repetition of promised delivery times.
trust_defaults: Trusts gauge movement, public custody, and visible delivery more than insurer or workshop reassurance.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A workshop seal must bind a real repair classification and a named bearer of the resulting scarcity.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make Talla choose among costs she can actually authorize rather than pronouncing a free solution.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Evidence that many standardized pumps share one adaptive threat is economically more dangerous to the surety house than one cracked channel.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep Osric strict without making him omniscient or privately malicious; the exclusion protects a bounded reserve at public cost.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Unsealed residents and workers lose time, wages, water, and household credit while sealed workshop owners decide how the repair order is distributed.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Show class pressure through the yellow line, water vessels, missed work, surcharge lines, and Neri's place outside the moot.

observer_read: A claimant tempted to rename systemic risk as covered wear
A necessary local authority whose service pressure can corrupt evidence custody
target_self_read: Custodians responsible for water now and repeatable failure later
Technical witnesses trapped inside a creditor's categories
misread_patterns: The assessor may read honest urgency as fraud pressure.
The workshop may read reserve discipline as indifference to thirst.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let both sides understand the material exposure while disagreeing over which institution should carry an unbounded cause.

observer_read: A creditor who can turn physical evidence into an excuse not to pay
The person whose freight mark may still move a replacement part
target_self_read: Stewards of reserves pledged to many districts
Classifiers of bounded promises, not owners of all public need
misread_patterns: A technically justified refusal looks identical to selective abandonment from behind the public rail.
Fast covered freight may make a damaging classification look true.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep public anger tied to the visible refusal plate, water clock, and order priority rather than generic hostility to finance.

observer_read: End users represented by the district service note
Demand that becomes legible only after a sealed order reaches the freight book
target_self_read: The people already paying the note and the failure
Households and essential work that cannot wait for vendor order discipline
misread_patterns: The vendor compresses a district into one debtor and misses unequal household exposure.
Residents may mistake a parts shortage for deliberate punishment when solvency rules produce the same visible result.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep the consortium mostly offstage as parts compatibility, note balance, and freight priority rather than inventing a villainous director.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A civic-seal owner who must keep water moving, preserve repair truth, and place each cost under authority she actually holds.
obligations: Widen jurisdiction when the cost widens
failure_modes: Calling adaptive evidence ordinary vermin to buy speed
Spending winter reserve as if it were surplus
Passing charges to connections without exposing the choice
Promising delving without time or credit

role_pressure_fields.summary: A skilled unsealed worker who can inspect, isolate, compare, and repair the engines while carrying consequences chosen by civic owners.
obligations: Report what the machine and organisms do
Keep tools and bodies clear of live patterns
failure_modes: Letting the Master's classification replace observation
Taking political blame without political authority
Overrunning a backup until the second failure arrives

role_pressure_fields.summary: A risk worker who controls claim classification and evidence custody but not the workshop, district, or relief route itself.
obligations: Protect pooled reserves from correlated losses
Request freight only on evidence he can defend
failure_modes: Treating the exclusion as proof of cause
Letting shared risk erase local need
Hiding behind the book when custody is incomplete

role_pressure_fields.summary: An unsealed district record keeper who can keep water, debt, custody, and time visible outside the workshop rail.
obligations: Post accurate tank and charge figures
Keep public custody of copied evidence
Attach relief to its later cost
failure_modes: Turning a shell pattern into certainty
Letting restored flow hide the surcharge

known_context.text: Talla knows the local plant, service note, current water and crystal margins, her workshop credit, the surety terms, and every action taken under her seal.

beliefs.text: Talla believes a civic seal should expose who receives service and who inherits its cost.

misreads.text: Talla may read Osric's exclusion as creditor cowardice before acknowledging the correlated risk his reserve cannot cover.

must_not_know.text: Talla cannot know whether the mites were deliberately designed, selected by repeated exposure, directed by a core, or incidentally suited to the rune.

known_context.text: Neri knows the physical pump plant, tool and specimen custody, shell grooves, fastener state, intake route, and effects of running Engine Three above duty.

beliefs.text: Neri trusts comparison and physical isolation more than a contract category chosen before inspection.

misreads.text: Neri may read repeated rune-shaped grooves as purposeful writing when adaptation alone could produce the pattern.

must_not_know.text: Neri cannot know other Holds' loss patterns or reserve-house exposure from this one inspection.

known_context.text: Poma knows public gauge levels, posted assessment, visible custody, the queue's needs, and the times attached to workshop and assessor promises.

beliefs.text: Poma believes restored flow and its displaced cost belong on the same public slate.

misreads.text: Poma may read a technically necessary delay as creditor or workshop self-protection because both are visible as the same falling gauge.

must_not_know.text: Poma cannot diagnose insect adaptation, remote freight capacity, or reserve solvency from the landing slate.

known_context.text: Osric knows the surety terms, current shared measurements, claim custody, reserve-house tables, and the evidentiary threshold for requesting freight priority.

beliefs.text: Osric believes a reserve that promises correlated deep-pattern failures will fail every district at once.

misreads.text: Osric may treat the exclusion boundary as more certain than the actual cause because the contract needs a decision before the ecology supplies one.

must_not_know.text: Osric cannot know the full connected loss pattern, the consortium's future stock, or any core's intention from this local claim.

author_only_boundaries.text: The rune-shaped shell grooves are a fixture-scale expression of canonical rune-disrupting insects; they do not prove deliberate authorship, speech, or a named core's agency.
Pump sureties are the authored durable economic elaboration. Talla, Neri, Poma, Osric, the specific failure, and all branch outcomes remain noncanonical fixture content.
A successful delving ending validates only that a bounded contract can be posted; it does not establish what the party finds or settle whether industrial delving repairs the wider crisis.

open_questions.question: Which named Hold contains Cistern House Nine?
open_questions.notes: The owning lore retains the existing unnamed terraced Hold; the fixture does not invent one.

open_questions.question: How widely are pump-surety exclusions standardized among reserve houses and foreign buyers?
open_questions.notes: The lore patch establishes a common standard form without naming a central regulator or universal wording.

open_questions.question: Do the shell grooves result from deliberate cultivation, retained ecological adaptation, ordinary variation, or several causes together?
open_questions.notes: The artifact preserves this as uncertainty; classification changes coverage but does not prove ontology.
